title: Tetro Chain K Canonical Representation
description: A width x height grid with white, gray and black circle clues on grid lines (edge midpoints or interior corners), in doubled coordinates where cell (r, c) has its centre at (2r+1, 2c+1). The solver shades tetrominoes: each circle shows the majority of the cells it touches, the tetrominoes link through corners, and two of the same shape never touch.

dc.description: Doubled column coordinate, 1..2*width-1; at least one of dr, dc is even.
